name: Frontier Grass
description: Bright colony grass that covers the open ground around frontier outposts.
role: The default ground of the frontier and of any world that authors no floor of its own.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile of short, dense blades with no dominant shape.
artBrief.detail: Blade tips catch yellow-green light; a few darker tufts break the pattern.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Bright greens #2af202 and #2cea06 with yellow-green #c4ea06 tips.
artBrief.readability: Keep contrast low so entities read on top of it.
